description: A transparent, rule-based scoring and governance pipeline over curated evidence that investigates high-risk misinformation claims. 28 fixture-driven calibration claims with verdicts, scores, reports, and signed PDFs. Read-only: no write operations.
limitations: Rule-based pipeline, no LLM in reasoning path. Calibration is table-driven (verdicts follow hard-coded evidence tables). Fixture mode is the reproducible path; live adapters require API keys.
name: TruthOps

skills.description: Browse the 28 calibrated claims with verdicts, scores, evidence counts, trace IDs, and links to Markdown reports, signed PDFs, and terminal recordings.
skills.name: browse_claims
